questions.question: What is your connection to Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and what do you hope to gain from participating in this group?
What is the name of the big festival hosted in Bethlehem each August?

description_with_entities.text: Please keep posts about Bethlehem Pennsylvania
If you’re going to complain about something you have to also suggest a way that we can fix it. This is not the place to complain for its own sake.

If you would like to ask for recommendations, we highly suggest Recommendations of Bethlehem, PA and Greater Lehigh Valley Region. 
Friends of Bethlehem has been getting an over abundance of recommendation posts which are basically the same recommendations over and over again. Google is quicker for sure. 
We want to have the best content we can, so we will limit those types of posts.

nodes.rule_title: Not a Buy/Sell or Fundraising Group

description_with_entities.text: This isn't a place to advertise your business, real estate, job listings, or to buy/sell things, or to give things away for free. This is not a place to advertise your fundraiser or charity. It's not a place ask for employment or real estate advice. This is also not a place to advertise foreign exchange student placements (seriously, we get a ton of these).
Losing a pet is a big deal. To report a lost pet we recommend posting it to Lost & Found Pets - Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania

nodes.rule_title: No Nicknames; Don't Turn Off Commenting

description_with_entities.text:
We don't allow anonymous posting in this group, so unless there is a really good reason, nickname posts and comments will all be declined. This feature has been used in other groups with undesirable results.

Shutting down comments is against the spirit of this group. Posts where this has been observed will be removed unless there is a good reason not to.

nodes.rule_title: Be Kind and Courteous. Don't be a jerk

description_with_entities.text:
Make sure everyone feels safe. Bullying, threats, or intimidation of any kind isn't allowed, and degrading comments about things like race, religion, culture, sexual orientation, gender or identity will not be tolerated.

We're all in this together to create a welcoming environment. Let's treat everyone with respect. Healthy debates are natural, but kindness is required. Foul language is not appreciated.

nodes.rule_title: Make Sure The Content You're Sharing Is Public

description_with_entities.text:
If a Facebook post you share isn't set to public, we'll get a "This content isn't available right now" message, so double-check that you see the little globe icon to indicate everyone can view it.

Please only share links to external sites that are not behind a paywall.
Discussions about controversial topics that directly affect Bethlehem are allowed, but please cite a reputable source of information.
If there is a questionable post or comment we may need to follow up with the poster to clarify. If you block the moderation team we can't do that.

group.participation_questionnaire_explanation_: You're almost ready to post and comment. Help admins get to know you by answering these questions.

questions.question:
Answering these questions is required to be accepted into the group.

Have you in the past, or currently, reside in Bethlehem?
What is a general complaint you have about Bethlehem?

description_with_entities.text: This group is for complaining about Bethlehem. If it isn't a complaint, or it isn't specific to Bethlehem, it may be removed. We let it slide on occasion.
Harassment/Bullying. If you have a problem with someone, block them. It will save a lot of heartache in the long run.
No Doxing (Leaking personal information of a person or persons)
Posts and comments that flagrantly disregard or promote the disregard of public health and safety will be removed and you will likely be blocked without notice.
No attacks against Race, Color, Religion or creed, National origin or ancestry, Sex, Age, Physical or mental disability, Veteran status, Citizenship.
The moderation team reserves the right to remove your post at will. This will not be rampant or abused. If your post is removed and you aren't sure why, message the moderators.
Blocking modmins impedes our ability to moderate the group. You'll be kicked without warning.
If you share an attachment to the group, please make sure the post is view able as "Public" or no one will be able to view the attachment. If not, the post will be deleted.
Users cannot turn off comments on their posts. If a user repeatedly turns off commenting they may be removed from the group.
